main_info.name: Aga Khan University
main_info.description: A pioneering, not-for-profit international university committed to the development of human capacities through the discovery and dissemination of knowledge, operating campuses in Pakistan, East Africa, and the UK.
main_info.verification_note: Identity fields sourced from resources/rankings_pk.json registry.

undergraduate.name: Bachelor of Science in Midwifery, Tanzania
undergraduate.career_prospects: Provide competent healthcare and holistic reproductive, maternal, newborn and childcare.
undergraduate.summary_3_lines:
Designed to prepare nurse midwives to provide competent healthcare.
Provides an opportunity to develop in-depth knowledge, skills, and attitudes.
Focuses on holistic reproductive, maternal, newborn and childcare.

undergraduate.name: Bachelor of Science in Nursing
undergraduate.career_prospects: Eligible to receive the license of Registered Nurse.
undergraduate.summary_3_lines:
Equips students with knowledge, skills and attitude needed to practice nursing.
Designed to prepare clinically competent professional nurses.
Requires a mandatory one-year internship.

undergraduate.name: Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Kenya
undergraduate.career_prospects: Eligible to enter the nursing profession as intern nurses.
undergraduate.summary_3_lines:
Aims to equip nursing students with skills for patient-centered care and teamwork.
Direct-entry programme focusing on evidence-based practice and quality improvement.
Requires a one-year internship to qualify for a professional nursing license.

undergraduate.name: Bachelor of Midwifery Science (Post-RM), Uganda
undergraduate.career_prospects: Provides registered midwives with an opportunity to upgrade their diploma qualification to a degree.
undergraduate.summary_3_lines:
Prepares nurses to provide safe, competent, and culturally responsive care.
Focuses on reproductive, maternal, newborn and child health for families.
Integrates knowledge, skills, and attitudes from humanistic and behavioral sciences.

undergraduate.name: Bachelor of Nursing Science – Direct Entry, Uganda
undergraduate.career_prospects: Prepared to deliver compassionate care and work in multidisciplinary environments.
undergraduate.summary_3_lines:
Equips nurses with essential skills for today's healthcare environment.
Emphasizes patient-centered care, critical thinking, and teamwork.
Leverages innovations in electronic health records, telemedicine, and data science.

undergraduate.name: Post-RN Bachelor of Science in Midwifery, Kenya
undergraduate.career_prospects: Allows nurses and midwives to continue working while achieving a higher-level qualification.
undergraduate.summary_3_lines:
Prepares midwives to provide safe, competent, and culturally responsive care.
Work and learn format allows professionals to study while continuing to work.
Enhances capacity to serve at all levels of the healthcare system.

undergraduate.name: Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Tanzania
undergraduate.scholarships_info: Merit- and needs-based financial assistance and scholarships
undergraduate.career_prospects: Eligible to enter the nursing profession as intern nurses.
undergraduate.summary_3_lines:
Direct-entry programme equipping students with skills for patient-centered care.
Focuses on teamwork, interprofessional practice, and evidence-based care.
Requires passing the Tanzania Nursing and Midwifery Council licensure exam.

undergraduate.name: Bachelor of Studies in Arts and Sciences
undergraduate.career_prospects: Prepares graduates for innovative thought and consequential action as future leaders.
undergraduate.summary_3_lines:
Transformative programme with a deeply integrated and holistic academic structure.
Offers interdisciplinary majors including Philosophy, Politics, and Economics.
Features a Core Curriculum, Senior Thesis, and Experiential Learning.

undergraduate.name: Post-RM Bachelor of Science in Midwifery
undergraduate.summary_3_lines:
Prepares graduates to provide comprehensive, evidence-based midwifery care.
Offers a unique blend of face-to-face and distance-learning approaches.
Spread over four semesters of 18 weeks each.

undergraduate.name: Post-RN Bachelor of Science in Nursing
undergraduate.career_prospects: Graduates will be able to provide leadership and influence the development of the nursing profession.
undergraduate.summary_3_lines:
Designed to give experienced Registered Nurses advanced knowledge and skills.
Focuses on clinically competent professional nursing care.
Requires a three-year RN Diploma for admission eligibility.

undergraduate.name: Post-RN Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Kenya
undergraduate.career_prospects: Opportunity for senior registered nurses to upgrade their diploma to a degree level.
undergraduate.summary_3_lines:
Designed for senior registered nurses to upgrade their qualifications.
Provides an opportunity to develop in-depth knowledge and attitudes.
Focuses on holistic nursing care within East Africa.

undergraduate.name: Post-RN Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Tanzania
undergraduate.career_prospects: Upgrades a diploma qualification to a full degree level.
undergraduate.summary_3_lines:
Designed for senior registered nurses to advance their education.
Develops skills necessary to provide holistic nursing care.
Equips nurses to leverage technology and advanced competencies.

undergraduate.name: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)
undergraduate.career_prospects: Prepares students to lead change in their societies and thrive in the global economy.
undergraduate.summary_3_lines:
Five-year medical programme open to all academically qualified candidates globally.
Curriculum emphasizes problem-based learning and early clinical contact.
Provides opportunities to work in clinical teams at Aga Khan University Hospital.

undergraduate.name: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBChB)
undergraduate.career_prospects: Capable of managing health problems through collaborative and strategic approaches.
undergraduate.summary_3_lines:
Six-year medical degree preparing doctors well-grounded in humanities and medical sciences.
Fosters learning through problem-based and self-directed study.
Develops graduates capable of advancing the well-being of communities.

undergraduate.name: Bachelor of Education (BEd)
undergraduate.career_prospects: Nurtures empathetic and socially responsible teachers.
undergraduate.summary_3_lines:
Aims to build the capacity of teachers for meaningful learning experiences.
Offers specialisations in Mathematics, Science, English, and ECED.
Can be completed in 1.5 years full-time or up to 3 years part-time.

graduate.name: Master of Philosophy (MPhil) in Education
graduate.career_prospects: Researchers, heads of educational institutions, faculty, project leaders, and education consultants.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
Builds a strong research foundation to inquire into critical educational issues.
Prepares graduates to work as independent researchers with robust methodological skills.
Equips students to bridge the gap between educational theory, policy, and practice.

graduate.name: Master of Education (MEd)
graduate.career_prospects: Exemplary teachers, teacher trainers, principals, and educational leaders.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
An intensive graduate programme for experienced educators and professionals.
Provides a clear theoretical framework to support quality professional practice.
Equips participants to become exemplary teachers in diverse contexts.

graduate.name: Master of Science in Nursing (MScN)
graduate.career_prospects: Advanced practice nurses, clinical scholars, and nursing educators.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
Prepares advanced practice nurses to solve complex health problems scientifically.
Emphasizes nursing practice in both rural and urban healthcare settings.
Allows students to select specialized areas of advanced nursing practice.

graduate.name: Master of Science (MSc) in Epidemiology and Biostatistics
graduate.career_prospects: Public health leaders, clinical researchers, and academicians.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
Trains health professionals in epidemiology, biostatistics, and public health analysis.
Focuses on regional health problems in Pakistan and other developing countries.
Offers a specialized clinical research track for aspiring academic researchers.

graduate.name: Master of Health Policy and Management (MHPM)
graduate.career_prospects: Health policy analysts, institutional managers, and strategic planners.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
Trains professionals in strategic planning and healthcare policy analysis.
Focuses on institutional management and health systems research and development.
Accredited as a Type II-B master's degree by the Pakistan Medical Commission.

graduate.name: Master of Health Professions Education (MHPE)
graduate.career_prospects: Educational leaders, innovators, and academic researchers in health professions.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
Develops excellent teachers, innovators, and researchers in health professions education.
Utilizes best-evidence medical education to improve academic standards globally.
Prepares leaders for undergraduate, postgraduate, and continuing health education.

graduate.name: Master of Philosophy (MPhil) in Biological and Biomedical Sciences
graduate.career_prospects: Biomedical scientists in academia, industry, or pathways to PhD training.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
Produces competent biomedical scientists with integrated concepts of basic health sciences.
Offers specialized streams in Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry, and Pharmacology.
Provides a strong foundation for future doctoral research and scientific inquiry.

graduate.name: Master of Science in Public Health (MSPH)
graduate.career_prospects: Public health leaders and system managers in public, private, and academic sectors.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
Addresses the need for trained public health professionals in LMICs.
Features an innovative curriculum designed to develop public health leaders.
Equips graduates to solve the plethora of health problems facing the region.

graduate.name: Master of Bioethics (MBE)
graduate.career_prospects: Bioethics educators, policymakers, researchers, and hospital administrators.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
Designed for professionals aspiring to gain in-depth knowledge of bioethics.
Caters to health professionals, lawyers, journalists, and policy makers.
Prepares graduates to establish bioethics educational programs and services.

graduate.name: Master of Science in Healthcare Management (MSHM)
graduate.career_prospects: Healthcare organization managers and hospital administrators.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
Builds the planning and managerial capacities of healthcare managers.
Focuses on people-centered integrated health services based on Primary Health Care.
Includes a core hospital clerkship/internship project for practical experience.

graduate.name: Master of Early Child Development (MECD)
graduate.scholarships_info: Two scholarships available specifically for Syrian students covering full tuition.
graduate.career_prospects: Early child development specialists, researchers, and policymakers.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
Promotes human development through a multidisciplinary, integrated approach.
Combines education, service, and research to strengthen human resource capacity.
Aims to drive greater investment in Early Child Development programs.

graduate.name: Master of Science in Health Data Science (MSHDS)
graduate.career_prospects: Health data scientists in public health, epidemiology, and biomedical research.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
Meets the rapidly growing need for health data scientists in LMICs.
Combines expertise in epidemiology, biostatistics, computer science, and AI.
Equips graduates to analyze complex health data for evidence-based solutions.

graduate.name: Master of Science in Advanced Practice Nursing (MSc-APN)
graduate.career_prospects: Advanced clinical practitioners, nursing educators, and healthcare leaders.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
A work-study programme allowing candidates to study while continuing to work.
Prepares nurses to develop innovative solutions to complex health problems.
Builds decision-making skills in advanced clinical practice and nursing education.

graduate.name: Master of Science in Advanced Practice Midwifery (MSc-APM)
graduate.career_prospects: Advanced midwifery practitioners and educators capable of independent care.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
Prepares advanced practice midwives to solve complex maternal health problems.
Develops leaders with strong decision-making skills in clinical practice.
Provides necessary skills to conduct research defining the discipline of midwifery.

graduate.name: Master of Medicine (MMed)
graduate.career_prospects: Specialized medical practitioners and consultants in diverse clinical fields.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
Offered in multiple clinical disciplines at AKU Hospitals in East Africa.
Provides rigorous clinical training and residency for future medical specialists.
Requires candidates to be registered with relevant regional medical councils.

graduate.name: Master of Arts in Digital Journalism
graduate.department: Graduate School of Media and Communications
graduate.career_prospects: Leading digital journalists, editors, and media executives.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
Combines real-life practice with academic rigor for early and mid-career journalists.
Develops knowledge and professional qualities for success at the highest media levels.
Offers an opportunity to work with world-renowned journalists and scholars.

graduate.name: Executive Masters in Media Leadership and Innovation
graduate.department: Graduate School of Media and Communications
graduate.career_prospects: Media business leaders, entrepreneurs, and senior media executives.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
An MBA-style programme focused on media viability and strategic leadership.
Promotes innovative solutions to the media's current and future problems.
Develops entrepreneurial skills to commence new businesses or transform firms.

graduate.name: Master of Arts in Strategic Communications
graduate.department: Graduate School of Media and Communications
graduate.career_prospects: Strategic communication professionals, public relations managers, and media advisors.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
Combines real-life practice with academic rigor for communication professionals.
Covers risk, crisis, health, development, political, and financial communications.
Leverages stakeholder insights to deliver powerful, action-inspiring messages.

graduate.name: Master of Arts in Muslim Cultures
graduate.department: Institute for the Study of Muslim Civilisations
graduate.career_prospects: Scholars, policy analysts, researchers, and global non-profit leaders.
graduate.summary_3_lines:
Provides expert insight into historical and contemporary Muslim cultures.
Equips students to engage critically with challenges faced by Muslim societies.
Applies a framework of humanities and social sciences to the study of Muslim contexts.

postgraduate_and_phd.name: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Education
postgraduate_and_phd.career_prospects: Leadership roles within research and education, scholars, education practitioners and policy makers.
postgraduate_and_phd.summary_3_lines:
Designed for professionals aspiring to improve education quality in Pakistan and the developing world.
Focuses on critiquing established ideas, generating indigenous knowledge, and designing innovative inquiry methods.
Equips candidates with skills required for leadership roles in research and education.

postgraduate_and_phd.name: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Health Sciences
postgraduate_and_phd.department: Medical College / School of Nursing and Midwifery
postgraduate_and_phd.career_prospects: Clinical scholars and faculty members capable of scientific inquiry for innovative practice and knowledge development.
postgraduate_and_phd.summary_3_lines:
An interdisciplinary and multidisciplinary programme with broad areas of study.
Offers specialisations in Biological Sciences, Clinical Sciences, and Population and Public Health.
Central to the mission of producing research-based knowledge relevant to the developing world.

postgraduate_and_phd.name: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in History / Political Science
postgraduate_and_phd.department: Institute for the Study of Muslim Civilisations
postgraduate_and_phd.scholarships_info: UKRI grants, ERC funding, and other institutional funding opportunities
postgraduate_and_phd.career_prospects: Academia, management consultancy, policy advising, think tanks, charities, NGOs, journalism, and media.
postgraduate_and_phd.summary_3_lines:
Trains researchers to conduct independent research focusing on Muslim cultures.
Develops an advanced understanding of the diversity of Muslim cultures and their historical and contemporary significance.
Offers dual supervision, including external university supervisors at no additional cost.

faculties.faculty_name: Faculty of Arts and Sciences, Pakistan
faculties.description: The Faculty of Arts and Sciences (FAS) will develop young people to become future leaders through a transformative education that is endlessly challenging, stimulating and mind-opening – one that prepares graduates for innovative thought and consequential action.

faculties.faculty_name: School of Nursing and Midwifery, East Africa
School of Nursing and Midwifery, Pakistan
faculties.description: Established in 1980, the School of Nursing and Midwifery in Pakistan is the founding academic entity of the University and has been a benchmark for nursing education in Pakistan. The school is committed to excellence in the fields of education, practice, research and administration.

departments: Division of Woman and Child Health

faculties.faculty_name: Graduate School of Media and Communications
faculties.description: Launched in 2015, the Aga Khan University Graduate School of Media and Communications (GSMC) is the premier source of education providing tailored training for journalists, communicators, media executives and entrepreneurs in East Africa and beyond.

faculties.faculty_name: Institute for Educational Development, East Africa
faculties.description: With its cutting edge, regionally relevant research and leading academic staff, The Institute for Educational Development strives to improve the quality of education in East Africa by offering graduate degrees in education as full-time and part-time; tailored professional development courses; educational interventions and influence educational policies by working with communities and other stakeholders.

faculties.faculty_name: Institute for the Study of Muslim Civilisations
faculties.description: Established in 2002, the Aga Khan University Institute for the Study of Muslim Civilisations (AKU-ISMC) is a non-denominational, research-driven liberal arts institute. It has gained international recognition for its impactful research, education, and outreach initiatives.

Understanding and supporting the development of people in the day-to-day contexts in which they live and experience their multiple worlds are fundamental to any society's hope of attaining a high quality of life and well-being for its citizens.
